A1-A3 (Kernel).axiom: A1–A3 (Kernel): Autonomy, Impulse, and Quality Gate: internal deficit δ_i drives action probability p_i(t) = σ(D(δ_i(t))), reduced by action quality g.
A1-A3 (Kernel).rationale: Coherent drive-to-action mapping akin to homeostatic/allostatic control and active inference policy selection. Predicts monotonic p_i(δ_i) and performance modulation by quality gate. Kernel is essential and non-derivable from later axioms.
A1-A3 (Kernel).concerns: Clarify D, g, and sign conventions; how quality reduces probability; multi-action coupling; stochasticity source.

A4 (Saliency as gate).axiom: A4 (Saliency as gate): Not every observation enters the context. An attention operator A selects õ_t = A(o_t, I_t, D_t, M_t; x_{A,t}).
A4 (Saliency as gate).rationale: Clear, non-contradictory gating proposal integrating exteroceptive, interoceptive, drive, and memory signals. Adds a distinct selection mechanism beyond the kernel and A5–A9. Biologically consonant with salience network, thalamic gating, and predictive-coding precision control. Falsifiable by ablations/testing whether I_t/D_t/M_t alter token/context selection and downstream behavior. Minor redundancy with A6 and unclear 'context' definition temper scores.
A4 (Saliency as gate).concerns: Define 'context' and the type of õ_t; clarify boundary with P (is A before/after perceptual feature extraction?); justify explicit M_t input given A6’s ubiquitous prior; specify learning/dynamics of x_{A,t} and timescale links to SAM/HPA; outline quantitative falsification tests (e.g., precision-weight changes predicting attention allocation).

A5 (Interoception as parallel input).axiom: A5 (Interoception as parallel input): A body signal I_t feeds into E and A without passing through P.
A5 (Interoception as parallel input).rationale: Direct interoceptive inputs to attention and emotion align with salience network and interoceptive inference (insula/ACC, amygdala). Adds a distinct pathway beyond A4. However, the 'without passing through P' claim is too absolute—interoception has perceptual hierarchies—and it omits routes to cognition/hormonal control. Testable via ablation/lesion studies in agents.
A5 (Interoception as parallel input).concerns: Clarify whether P includes interoceptive perception; justify exclusion of C/H pathways; specify timescale coupling with H; integrate precision-weighted gating (A4/A8) for I_t; define measurable I_t proxies for LLM-agents.

A6 (Memory as ubiquitous prior).axiom: A6 (Memory as ubiquitous prior): A state M_t biases all subsystems and updates post-action.
A6 (Memory as ubiquitous prior).rationale: Coherent and matches a Bayesian prior view; extends A4 by making memory global and updating post-action. Grounded in predictive coding/allostasis/constructed-emotion where memory shapes perception, interoception, valuation; but 'biases all subsystems' is strong. Falsifiable via ablations measuring subsystem sensitivity to M_t and post-action updates in LLM-agents.
A6 (Memory as ubiquitous prior).concerns: Over-broad universal claim; specify which parameters in each subsystem are biased (e.g., means vs precisions), timescales, and update rule. Risk of redundancy with D_t set-points and saliency gate; identifiability issues. Clarify whether hormonal axis H is directly memory-modulated and how to operationalize falsification across all subsystems.

A7 (Drives as set-point generators).axiom: A7 (Drives as set-point generators): Set-points are not constants: x*_t = D_t.
A7 (Drives as set-point generators).rationale: Expresses allostasis (variable defended values) distinct from other axioms. But x*_t = D_t risks unit mismatch and circularity with deficits. Biology supports modulatory shifts via SAM/HPA and predictive coding, not literal equality. Falsifiable by showing drive manipulations shift internal targets independently of immediate action probability.
A7 (Drives as set-point generators).concerns: Type/units unclear (are D_t and x* commensurate?); circularity if δ uses x* while D_t depends on δ; missing update law and timescale; potential instability. Prefer x*_t = f(D_t, M_t, I_t) with explicit typing and convergence/stability conditions.

A8 (Fast/slow parallelism with arbitrato.axiom: A8 (Fast/slow parallelism with arbitrator): Two routes produce action candidates c_fast, c_slow; an arbitrator assigns precision weights π_fast, π_slow.
A8 (Fast/slow parallelism with arbitrato.rationale: Clear, non-contradictory dual-route arbitration aligns with dual-process accounts, cortico-basal ganglia arbitration, and predictive-coding precision. It adds structure absent in A1-A7 and is testable via volatility manipulations. Weaknesses: 'precision' and its estimation/normalization are unspecified; mapping to hormonal timescales is asserted but not mechanistically tied to the arbitrator.
A8 (Fast/slow parallelism with arbitrato.concerns: Define how π_fast, π_slow are computed, bounded, and learned; specify whether they sum to 1 and depend on uncertainty/volatility; clarify how arbitration interfaces with A1-A3 action probability and g; justify biological mapping of fast (SAM) vs slow (HPA) routes; consider more than two routes or hierarchical arbitration.

A9 (Recursive closure).axiom: A9 (Recursive closure): Γ is self-applicable: Γ(Γ(·)) preserves type signature, enabling VSM recursion.
A9 (Recursive closure).rationale: Clear statement of closure/recursion distinct from A1–A8. Coheres with VSM and hierarchical predictive coding’s self-similar control motifs, but biological evidence for exact self-application is thin. Type-preservation is asserted, not derived; may conflict with heterogeneous timescales/interfaces (SAM vs HPA). Falsifiability is weak: mostly architectural; can be probed only by agent ablations/performance under added recursion.
A9 (Recursive closure).concerns: Ill-defined typing of Γ’s inputs/outputs; unclear shared state across A,P,H,E,N,C. Risk of regress/oscillation without contraction or stability constraints. Precision arbitration across levels unspecified; potential double-counting of memory/drives. Biological mapping of exact self-application across SAM/HPA is unmotivated. Specify interfaces, termination/stopping rules, and measurable invariants.
